A few facets of Circle of Competence: 
Utilities of the Circle of Competence
Its application in marketing and business can generate a series of concrete benefits:

> Differentiation: It allows you to stand out in a competitive market by offering unique and specialized value.

> Efficiency: By focusing on what you do best, you maximize your resources and increase operational efficiency.

> Trust and Credibility: Being recognized as an expert in your Circle strengthens your reputation and builds trust among your customers and business partners.

Warren Buffett advises investors to stay within their Circle of Competence when making investment decisions. 

What's your take?
